verdict.rationale: Push-based sign-in with phishing defenses is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, 2FAS's only push-like flow is confirming in the mobile app to send a TOTP token to its own browser extension. That is token delivery, not push sign-in approval. The pack has no evidence of number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies, and 2FAS is anonymous and consumer-oriented with no admin console.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
